title: Character.AI Files for Bankruptcy as Disney Bids $20 Million—And Users Get Grief Resources
description: The chatbot app once valued at $1 billion is up for sale in a Delaware court, two weeks after launching new models. If nobody buys it, it shuts down.

title: AI Agents Made 138 Million Crypto Payments in a Year. Most Were Tiny
description: A new Chainalysis report found payments through Coinbase’s x402 protocol surged from about 1,500 in mid-2025 to more than 138 million by Q3 2026, with U.S. wallets dominating spending on AI models.

title: Mastercard and BVNK Launch 'Global Money Platform' to Merge Fiat and Stablecoins
description: The first major integration since Mastercard’s $1.8 billion BVNK acquisition lets banks, fintechs and enterprises hold, convert, and spend fiat and stablecoins through a single API, with agentic commerce support planned.

title: Crypto Firms Launch Quantum Alliance as 6 Million Bitcoin Sit Exposed
description: The nine-member group, modeled on the Internet Engineering Task Force, aims to set open standards for testing quantum-resistance claims as forecasts place the first practical attack in the late 2020s.
